This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: The evaluated work is image classification, not a demonstrated treatment simulator or temporal patient model; the treatment/personalization language is not supported by treatment-conditioned or longitudinal experiments. The PDF reports 98.73% classification accuracy. The narrative is internally inconsistent about the clinical application versus culture/image classification; model and data details are not fully clear. Table I was readable in extracted text; figures were not needed for the extracted fields. Evidence QA: 3/11 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (27.3%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 13 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 1 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis.
